## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): electron n = +3.2×10¹², hole n = −1.2×10¹²

Raw first, then FFT (B ≥ 1 T, the 10/20 mT legs), tone tracking (`sdh_onset`), and the model overlay (`fs_count_b0`, run-5 calibration).

**Read (electron, run 6):** four tones — **7.11 T** (onset *censored*: above threshold down to the fine leg's 1 T edge; the 50 mT coarse leg below 1 T is Nyquist-blind to it), **22.08 T** (onset 1.36 T), **14.08 ≈ 2×7.11** (light-tone harmonic), **29.47 ≈ 7.11+22.08** (sum tone; strengthens relative to the fundamentals in the high-B half — magnetic-breakdown-consistent, expected/symmetry-allowed for ABAB). Luttinger: 7.11 + 22.08 = 29.19 = **0.88·F_L** (F_L = 33.09 T) — a pair summing to F_L at a single global scale 0.88, inside the lever-arm prior. Partition 0.244/0.756 vs model ABAB 0.221/0.779 at n = +3.2×10¹²; model frequencies 7.31/25.78 T. **ABAB-consistent two-FS structure** — but pair-sums-to-F_L is necessary, not sufficient: the call needs the F(n) trajectory (fan) + dual-family overlay + F_L-tone origin + LK.

**Read (hole, run 7):** close balanced pair **4.72 / 6.59 T**, sum 11.31 = **0.91·F_L** (F_L = 12.41 T) — the expected ABAB near-CNP semimetal exception regime (model 5.3/7.1 at −1.2×10¹²); 9.38 ≈ 2×4.72. Resolution-limited (few periods above onset) — consistent-with, not classification-grade. **Fan side: electron** — higher |n| reach (templates separate), censored (deeper) onset, cleaner tones.

**Hands to the fan:** sensitivity 50 µV (5 kΩ FS, worst corner ≈ 600 Ω at 12% FS), τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, I_bias 10 nA; onset ≤ 1 T but **unpinned (censored)** → low-field extension (5 mT, 0 → 1.3 T) pins B_lo before the fan; it doubles as the grid-change reproduction of the 7.1 T tone.

# Runs 6-7 sdh-spot-check analysis: raw -> FFT -> tones vs F_L and model
import sys
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, sdh_onset, sdh_fft, luttinger_frequency
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/hera/measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count")
from fs_count_b0 import abab_fs

I_BIAS = 10e-9
runs = {6: ("electron", +3.2e12), 7: ("hole", -1.2e12)}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 8))
tone_sets = {}
for row, (rid, (side, n_cm2)) in enumerate(runs.items()):
    r = open_run(f"data/{rid}")
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); R = r.col("sr1_X") / I_BIAS  # sr1 gain 1
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    F_L = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(n_cm2) * 1e4))

    ax = axes[row, 0]  # raw FIRST
    ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.5)
    ax.set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ω)", title=f"run {rid} raw — {side} n={n_cm2/1e12:+.1f}e12")

    onset = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=0.3)
    tone_sets[rid] = onset
    fr, amp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(1.0, float(B.max())), nfft=4096, log=False)
    a = np.asarray(amp).reshape(-1, len(fr))[0]
    ax = axes[row, 1]
    ax.plot(fr, a, lw=0.8)
    ax.axvline(F_L, color="k", ls="--", label=f"F_L = {F_L:.1f} T")
    _, orbs = abab_fs(n_cm2 * 1e4)
    for F, _kf in orbs:
        ax.axvline(F, color="C3", ls=":", alpha=0.8)
    ax.set(xlim=(0, 1.6 * F_L), xlabel="F (T)", title=f"run {rid} FFT 1–{B.max():.0f} T (red: model ABAB)")
    ax.legend(fontsize=8)

    ax = axes[row, 2]  # B-window split: breakdown/mixing tones strengthen with B
    Bmax = float(B.max()); Bmid = 0.5 * (1.0 + Bmax)
    for (b1, b2), c in [((1.0, Bmid), "C0"), ((Bmid, Bmax), "C1")]:
        fr2, amp2 = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(b1, b2), nfft=4096, log=False)
        a2 = np.asarray(amp2).reshape(-1, len(fr2))[0]
        ax.plot(fr2, a2 / a2.max(), lw=0.8, color=c, label=f"{b1:.1f}–{b2:.1f} T")
    ax.axvline(F_L, color="k", ls="--")
    ax.set(xlim=(0, 1.6 * F_L), xlabel="F (T)", title=f"run {rid} B-window split (norm)")
    ax.legend(fontsize=8)

    print(f"run {rid} ({side}, n={n_cm2/1e12:+.1f}e12): F_L={F_L:.2f} T, onset_b={onset.onset_b:.2f} T")
    for t in onset.tones:
        print(f"  f={t.freq:6.2f} T  onset={t.onset_b:5.2f} T  censored={t.censored}  f/F_L={t.freq/F_L:.3f}")

fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# Luttinger + partition, electron pair (7.11, 22.08) and hole pair (4.72, 6.59)
for rid, (f1, f2) in {6: (7.11, 22.08), 7: (4.72, 6.59)}.items():
    n = runs[rid][1]; F_L = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(n) * 1e4))
    print(f"run {rid}: f1+f2 = {f1+f2:.2f} T vs F_L = {F_L:.2f} -> scale {(f1+f2)/F_L:.3f}; "
          f"partition {f1/(f1+f2):.3f}/{f2/(f1+f2):.3f}")

## HERA — SdH onset pin (`sdh-spot-check` low-field extension), electron spot n = +3.2×10¹², B 0 → 1.3 T at 5 mT

> **05:25** · SdH onset pin: electron spot n=+3.2e12 D=0, B 0->1.3 T at 5 mT (261 pts), sr1 50 uV, delay 0 (3 s settle); ends 1.3 T, gates at spot · **ETA ~06:00** (≈35 min)

Run 6's carrying tone (7.11 T, the ABAB-candidate light pocket) is **censored** — above threshold down to the fine leg's 1 T edge, and the 50 mT coarse leg below 1 T is Nyquist-blind to it (period ΔB = B²/f ≈ 35 mT at 0.5 T). Per `landau-fan` step 1: a censored carrying tone means the onset was never captured — pin it with a cheap low-field extension **before** committing the multi-hour fan, since `B_lo` prices both the fan's row count (Δ(1/B) span) and its n-axis Nyquist floor. 5 mT sampling resolves the 7.1 T tone down to ≈ 0.25 T. This run **doubles as the investigation's grid-change reproduction check** on the light tone (5 mT vs run 6's 10 mT, retiring sampling-alias origins). Same acquisition as run 6 (50 µV, τ = 0.3 s, delay 0 with the 3 s blocking-settle = 10τ). Preconditions: magnet at 0 (handoff state), gates ramp 0 → spot in-cell. Ends at **1.3 T with gates at the spot** — the fan positions down from there to its measured B_lo, never re-traversing. Checkpoint: first rows (signal, sensitivity, leakage); read = `sdh_onset` on the joint low-field record.

# === SdH onset pin (`sdh-spot-check` low-field extension): n = +3.2e12, D = 0, B 0 -> 1.3 T at 5 mT ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)  # run-5 calibration
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: sweep starts at 0), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.0, 1.3001, 0.005), 4)   # 261 pts, resolves the 7.1 T tone to ~0.25 T
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)   # same acquisition as run 6
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, "
      f"tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"sdh-spot-check low-field onset pin, electron: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm, "
                  f"(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0 -> 1.3 T at 5 mT, sr1 50 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'low-field onset pin (run-6 carrying tone censored at 1 T): n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, '
              f'D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); B 0 -> 1.3 T, 5 mT uniform; '
              f'grid-change reproduction of the 7.1 T tone; cal run 5')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field stays at 1.3 T — the fan positions down from here to its measured B_lo.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")

Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
